name: dsh-card-export
description: Report and conversation export for DeepSeek Harness: renders any Markdown report (fact-check reports get a summary card plus a full verbatim long image) and any DSH session excerpt into shareable PNG images. Zero npm dependencies — it drives the Chromium-family browser already on the machine (Edge → Chrome → others), degrades to PDF, then to HTML.

scripts.smoke: node tools/smoke-rasterize.mjs && node tools/smoke-readiness.mjs && node tools/smoke-report.mjs && node tools/smoke-transcript.mjs && node tools/smoke-dshui.mjs && node tools/smoke-factcheck-detect.mjs && node tools/smoke-plugin.mjs && node tools/smoke-crop.mjs && node tools/smoke-coverage.mjs && node tools/smoke-conformance.mjs && node tools/smoke-math.mjs
